claim_scope: small exploratory four-task blind pilot; useful for a mechanism check but not a powered or confirmatory speedup study

required_before_seed_reveal: all non-placeholder fields in this protocol
freeze_requirements.no_retuning_rule: After the seed reveal, do not change tasks, prompts, feedback, fallback, selector, budgets, model settings, code, seeds, endpoints, or analysis in response to any task or provider result. Never replace a hard or failed task.

blind_seed_commitment.preferred_custody: For this exploratory pilot, the frozen generator creates one OS-random 256-bit secret exactly once, writes it only to the private reveal, and the experiment runner never reads or receives that reveal before provider artifacts are sealed. An advisor-held secret remains preferable for a confirmatory study.
blind_seed_commitment.deterministic_derivation: Derive independent generator and run streams with SHA-256(revealed_secret || NUL || task_id || NUL || purpose || NUL || counter).
blind_seed_commitment.anti_cherry_pick_rule: Generate exactly the first structurally valid task for each frozen schedule slot; rejection is allowed only for the predeclared structural conditions below and every rejected counter and reason must be logged.

model.trajectory_replication_note: At temperature zero, different provider seeds are bookkeeping and are not claimed to be independent model replicates.

target_language.program: order-preserving filter followed by pointwise arithmetic map
target_language.predicate_composition: one atom or the conjunction of two atoms

fixed_family_schedule.predicate_family: bounded-open-interval: a < item and item < b

fixed_family_schedule.mapper_family: scale: a * item with a in {-3,-2,2,3,4}
shift: item + b, grammar-realizable and b != 0

fixed_family_schedule.predicate_family: bounded-open-interval: a < item and item < b

parameter_sampling.rule: Sample uniformly from the sorted grammar-realizable parameters in the scheduled family using the task-purpose stream; use deterministic rejection sampling only for a listed structural failure.

predeclared_structural_acceptance: The target predicate retains between three and five of the eight observed-domain values.
The target mapper has at least three distinct output values on the retained domain values.
The target predicate differs from the start predicate on at least two observed-domain values.
The target mapper differs from the start mapper on at least two target-retained values.
The deterministic initial complete program is not exact.
The target predicate and mapper are members of the frozen grammar.
The target joint finite-domain behavior has not appeared in an earlier schedule slot.
forbidden_rejection_reasons: initial or best loss magnitude beyond the listed non-exact check
human judgment that a task appears easy, hard, attractive, or unattractive
public_examples_in_frozen_order: all eight singleton lists in ascending domain order
the complete domain in ascending order
one task-seeded permutation of the complete domain
the concatenation of two independently task-seeded permutations of the complete domain
task_generator.example_balance_note: Each domain value appears once as a singleton and equally often across the three mixed examples; the examples expose pointwise evidence without exposing a target AST.
task_generator.output_generation_and_validation: Generate outputs by executing the hidden target, then independently verify filter decisions, mapped values, order preservation, repeated-item behavior, grammar membership, and every structural acceptance condition.
task_generator.public_task_naming: Use only opaque task IDs and generic names; family labels, parameters, target expressions, rejection logs, and target ASTs remain in the hidden manifest.

expected_initial_program_under_frozen_gr.validation: Abort before provider execution if start_seed=17 does not reproduce this syntax and its recorded finite-domain component signatures.

search.checkpoint_interpretation: Round checkpoints are fixed. A nonexact run consumes the listed proposal slots even for invalid shortlists; an underfilled semantic beam is cycled to schedule exactly two later-round expansions. Exact stopping or infrastructure abort can end earlier. Proposal slots are not claims of unique programs or independent model draws.
search.semantic_signature: predicate decisions and mapper values on sorted distinct scalar items in the task inputs
search.selector: deduplicate finite joint component cells; apply the frozen rank-2W loss quality gate; retain the best-loss anchor; fill by component novelty, loss, minimum signature distance, proposal order, parent rank, and seeded SHA-256
search.beam_transition: elitist pool of active parents plus valid children
search.provider_order_contract: Candidates are ordered most to least promising and order is retained as ordinal proposal rank.
supported_hole_policy: First repair any violated predicate facts certified by singleton public examples.
Then repair any violated mapper facts certified by retained singleton public examples.
Otherwise, if any mechanically certified predicate toggle exists, repair the predicate.
Otherwise, if any conditional mapper constraint exists, repair the mapper.

unsupported_fallback.trigger: Neither a mechanically certified predicate toggle nor a conditional mapper constraint exists for the state.
unsupported_fallback.rule: Repair the predicate in odd-numbered rounds and the mapper in even-numbered rounds.
unsupported_fallback.label: unsupported deterministic exploration
unsupported_fallback.prompt_disclosure: Tell the provider that no mechanically certified local constraint exists and that this hole was selected by the frozen exploration fallback; never fabricate a diagnosis or label the choice as interpreter-supported.
unsupported_fallback.justification: The target-independent fallback prevents absence of conservative local evidence from silently changing the fixed round budget.
unsupported_fallback.baseline_parity: Apply the identical fallback to the matched random beam.

exact_stop.initial_state: If the initial state is exact, stop before Round 1.
exact_stop.active_round_rule: At the start of a round, freeze the complete set of active beam-state expansions. If any generated child is exact, still complete every K-candidate expansion in that active set, then stop before starting another round.

search.invalid_policy: A semantically invalid, duplicate, or syntactic no-op shortlist consumes all four proposal slots for that expansion, produces no children, and receives no retry or backfill.
search.infrastructure_failure_policy: Abort and seal the affected task trajectory, retain the task in the four-task report, make no semantic retry, and report both a conservative intention-to-run failure count and the operational failure separately.

matched_random_baseline.policy: Use the identical task, initial state, feedback, unsupported fallback, semantic selector, K, W, round budget, slot accounting, active-round exact stopping, and no-op exclusion; replace only LLM-generated repairs with syntax-uniform legal non-no-op repairs sampled without replacement.
matched_random_baseline.seed_derivation: Derive each trial/round/parent stream from the frozen task baseline seed, task ID, trial index, round, parent rank, state ID, and hole with SHA-256.
reported_per_task_metrics: exact successes by proposal-slot checkpoints 29 and 37
success rate and two-sided 95% Wilson interval
best-loss distribution and fraction at most the LLM best loss
first-exact slot distribution conditional on success
proposal slots, physical state evaluations, and unique semantic cells
matched_random_baseline.comparison_unit: one complete beam trajectory under the same nominal proposal-slot budget

endpoints_and_reporting.primary_endpoint: Per-task and aggregate exact zero-loss discovery by completion of Round 4, no later than nominal proposal slot 29.
endpoints_and_reporting.secondary_endpoint: Per-task and aggregate exact zero-loss discovery by completion of Round 5, no later than nominal proposal slot 37.
endpoints_and_reporting.secondary_status: descriptive exploratory endpoint, not a replacement primary endpoint when Round 4 fails
endpoints_and_reporting.success_definition: The interpreter reports exact_program=true and total_loss=0 on every frozen public example.
required_llm_metrics: success and first-exact round, proposal slot, and physical state evaluation
all generated candidates and validation statuses
provider calls, elapsed time, token usage, proposal slots, physical evaluations, cache hits, and unique syntax and semantic counts
fallback invocations distinguished from interpreter-supported hole choices
endpoints_and_reporting.aggregate_reporting: Report X/4 successes at Round 4 and Round 5, all four task-level outcomes, and the corresponding matched-random estimates. With only four generated tasks, treat intervals and random-tail comparisons as descriptive rather than population-level confirmation.
endpoints_and_reporting.failed_task_rule: No task may be omitted, replaced, relabeled developmental, or moved out of the denominator after its seed is revealed.

allowed_request_information: the current task's public input-output examples
the current interpreter score and execution traces
mechanically derived feedback, or the explicit unsupported-fallback label
the finite typed operator and integer-constant encoding
round number and frozen maximum rounds
an explicit label and reason stating whether hole selection is mechanically supported or unsupported deterministic exploration
forbidden_request_information: target AST, target DSL, target family label, sampled target parameters, or hidden target manifest
component-catalog cardinalities, complete-program cardinality, exact-support count, or exhaustive loss table
another blind task's examples, target, provider output, or search result
unselected alternatives or raw provider outputs from earlier beam expansions
provider_leakage_policy.stateless_task_isolation: Start every provider request without cross-task conversational context. Within a task, pass only the frozen current-state interface, not an accumulating chat transcript.
provider_leakage_policy.audit: Before accepting a run, verify request JSON against an allowlist schema, seal every request and response hash, and verify that hidden-manifest fields were never serialized into provider requests.
provider_leakage_policy.necessary_disclosure_caveat: The provider necessarily sees examples and the typed grammar fragment and could infer aspects of the finite space. The claim is that generating K repairs does not require enumerating or explicitly disclosing the complete-program space, not that its size is unknowable.

unblinding_and_artifact_order: Freeze and hash code, prompts, model revision, method fields in this protocol, and analysis.

Run the frozen generator exactly once: it atomically draws an OS-random secret, generates exactly four tasks, emits the public seed/target commitments, and writes the secret and targets only to a private reveal.
Fill and publish the public task hashes, commitments, and hidden-manifest hash without reading or exposing hidden fields to the provider.
Run all four LLM trajectories in the frozen order and seal provider artifacts.
Audit provider leakage and verify all seals.
Unblind the hidden manifest for structural and reproducibility audits.
Publish every task outcome, rejection log, artifact hash, and protocol deviation.
permitted_claims_if_observed: On these four previously unseen generated tasks, the typed LLM beam found exact zero-loss programs on X tasks by 29 proposal slots and Y tasks by 37 proposal slots.
On these same frozen tasks and budgets, the observed LLM outcomes and losses can be compared descriptively with the matched random beam.
Each LLM expansion requested only four typed repairs and did not require enumerating or disclosing all complete programs to the provider.
Because every observed-domain singleton is included, an exact pointwise filter-map program agrees with the target behavior on arbitrary lists over that eight-value domain, modulo equivalent syntax.
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: The four-task pilot proves a general LLM search speedup.
The result establishes performance on million-, billion-, or otherwise larger program spaces.
The LLM recovered the unique hidden AST; zero-loss syntax aliases may exist.
The method performs valid importance sampling, posterior inference, or exact proposal-probability correction.
The provider could not infer the grammar size.
Proposal-slot performance is a wall-clock speedup.
Agreement on the eight-value domain proves behavior outside that domain.
Four temperature-zero task trajectories estimate model-seed variability or provide a powered confirmatory test.
